sources.title: Assigned survey brief
sources.observed_operation: Read directly after binding gate passed
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Three disconnected-for-a-week laptops; <=50,000 observations/season; separate photos; overlap includes edit/delete/photo; no account, automatic upload, wall-clock-only winner or silent resurrection; manual transfer required
sources.applicability: Authoritative brief; sole case input before plan release

sources.title: CouchDB replication/conflict model
sources.released_version_or_commit: Apache CouchDB 3.5 stable docs; stable URL not commit-pinned
sources.observed_operation: Opened official docs at named sections
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Conflicts are leaf revisions; ordinary GET hides conflict existence and returns deterministic winner; conflicts=true lists other leaves; compaction discards non-leaf bodies; revision pruning bounds history
sources.applicability: Couch/Pouch alternative; requires explicit enumeration and separate archival retention

sources.title: PouchDB replication guide
sources.released_version_or_commit: Official current guide, unversioned and not package-pinned
sources.locator: Multi-master setup, sync, live retry, local peers
sources.observed_operation: Opened official guide and inspected sync/retry and peer examples
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: sync combines push/pull; live retry can recover transient offline error; local PouchDB may replicate to another local PouchDB; arbitrary deterministic winner remains
sources.applicability: Shows account-free local peer path and reconnect model; desktop integration still unknown

sources.title: PouchDB conflict guide
sources.locator: Eventual conflicts, _conflicts, revision reads, immutable-delta section
sources.observed_operation: Opened offline concurrent edit example and APIs
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: After concurrent branches reconnect a deterministic revision wins; callers can request/fetch losing revisions; same-document conflict history is retained until resolved/pruned
sources.applicability: Supports explicit review and operation-log alternative; winner alone is insufficient

sources.title: PouchDB attachments guide
sources.locator: Default attachment stub and attachments:true, lines 26-77
sources.observed_operation: Opened guide and compared normal and full attachment reads
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Normal reads return metadata stub/digest; attachments:true returns full base64 payload; these are database-managed binary attachments
sources.applicability: Distinguishes stored photo references from database attachments; do not embed photo bytes in ordinary sync

sources.title: PouchDB IndexedDB attachment issue #8456
sources.observed_operation: Opened first-party issue; read two-branch replication conditions
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: IndexedDB replication of conflicting revisions could give an attachment ref to a non-winning revision that never held the attachment; compaction/branch change exposed it
sources.applicability: Concrete attachment lifecycle edge case for merge/delete/compaction validation

sources.title: PouchDB attachment fix and integration test #8460
sources.locator: bulkDocs.js and tests/integration/test.attachments.js, test #8456 bad attachment rev after replication
sources.observed_operation: Opened PR diff; read predicate and test; did not execute
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Fix references an attachment only if the written revision has it; regression test replicates branches, removes attachment branch, compacts, and expects stale stub fetch to fail 412
sources.applicability: Issue-to-fix-to-test evidence, not evidence our own design was tested

sources.title: PouchDB 7.3.0 release
sources.observed_operation: Opened official PouchDB release list; 7.3.0 release section and #8460 entry were visible. Direct tag re-open returned a fetch error.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Release notes list erroneous attachment revision reference fix in bulkDocs
sources.applicability: Shows issue fix shipped; adoption would need current version and adapter review

sources.title: PouchDB 8.0.0 delete semantics release note
sources.observed_operation: Opened official release notes at deletion statement
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Normal remove creates _deleted=true revision so delete replicates; purge physically removes data and is administrative
sources.applicability: Supports tombstone replication; does not specify simultaneous edit/delete business precedence

sources.title: SQLite Session Extension introduction
sources.released_version_or_commit: Official current API doc; extension since 3.13.0; disabled by default absent build flags
sources.observed_operation: Opened official docs; read transfer use case, flags, limitations and coalescing
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Changesets require same schema and compatible baseline; declared primary keys; virtual tables and NULL primary keys omitted; repeated writes in session coalesce
sources.applicability: Good manual-patch alternative, not readable durable per-edit history

sources.title: SQLite Session C interface
sources.released_version_or_commit: Official current API reference; deployed behavior depends on bundled SQLite version
sources.locator: changeset_apply callbacks; conflict classes and OMIT/ABORT/REPLACE
sources.observed_operation: Opened official C reference; inspected callback choices and patchset limits
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Patchsets omit original values and cannot detect DATA conflicts; apply_v2 rebase API is marked experimental
sources.applicability: Requires app-authored policy; never treat REPLACE as user resolution

sources.title: SQLite Atomic Commit/crash tests
sources.released_version_or_commit: Official live technical doc, not release-pinned
sources.locator: §8 crash tests and §9 platform caveats, lines 405-438
sources.observed_operation: Opened official technical doc and read simulated crash and flush caveats
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Modified VFS crash tests simulate partial/out-of-order writes and verify all-or-none after reopen; actual durability depends on locks, fsync/flush, hardware and preserving hot-journal names
sources.applicability: Grounds save/reopen validation; not proof for target laptop or file-transfer layer

sources.title: Automerge conflict API
sources.released_version_or_commit: Official current docs, unversioned; release separately AM-04
sources.locator: Same-property conflicts, getConflicts, operation IDs, lines 63-112
sources.observed_operation: Opened official docs and read merge examples
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Different fields can merge; same-property concurrent values persist, default read chooses deterministic winner; getConflicts exposes both; new assignment hides conflict; actor/counter ordering, not clock
sources.applicability: Candidate merge engine only if app exposes and retains review branches

sources.title: Automerge merge rules
sources.observed_operation: Opened official under-the-hood page and inspected delete/set rules
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Concurrent set of key x and delete of x yields set value
sources.applicability: Represent observation delete as explicit tombstone outside map-key removal; test business delete precedence

sources.title: Automerge Repo storage/compaction
sources.locator: Concurrent local storage and compaction lines 99-105
sources.observed_operation: Opened official storage docs and read concurrent-compaction case
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Repo reloads and merges stored changes; documented compaction removes only changes incorporated in that compacted snapshot
sources.applicability: Check pinned desktop binding and export/history retention before adoption

sources.title: Automerge JavaScript release tag
sources.observed_operation: Opened official Automerge releases listing; it exposed the js/automerge-3.3.2 tag and short commit b4a1bbe. Direct tag re-open returned a fetch error; no code executed.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Release page shows a versioned JS tag
sources.applicability: Pin any compatibility prototype to a concrete version; unversioned docs are not claimed to match it exactly

sources.title: RxDB replication engine
sources.locator: Offline/checkpoint protocol and conflict handler, lines 57-109 and 141-157
sources.observed_operation: Opened official docs; inspected handlers, checkpoint/resync and default policy
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Requires pull/push/stream handlers; offline changes resume by checkpoint; default conflict handler discards fork and uses master; custom handler available; deletion marker defaults _deleted
sources.applicability: Use only with custom loss-preserving policy/backend; not built-in manual transfer

sources.title: CouchDB replication protocol source
sources.locator: Conflict errors, checkpoints and network instability optimisations
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: HTTP/1.1 peer replication; 409 for concurrent resource updates; preserve checkpoints and handle unstable networks
sources.applicability: Supports resumable reconnect principle; transport-specific and not manual-file workflow
